legend: Monocarp is playing a game "Assimilation IV". In this game he manages a great empire: builds cities and conquers new lands.

Monocarp's empire has n%%ZSMJ0%% cities. In order to conquer new lands he plans to build one Monument in each city. The game is turn-based and, since Monocarp is still amateur, he builds exactly one Monument per turn.

Monocarp has m%%ZSMJ1%% points on the map he'd like to control using the constructed Monuments. For each point he knows the distance between it and each city. Monuments work in the following way: when built in some city, a Monument controls all points at distance at most 1%%ZSMJ2%% to this city. Next turn, the Monument controls all points at distance at most 2%%ZSMJ3%%, the turn after — at distance at most 3%%ZSMJ4%%, and so on. Monocarp will build n%%ZSMJ5%% Monuments in n%%ZSMJ6%% turns and his empire will conquer all points that are controlled by at least one Monument.

Monocarp can't figure out any strategy, so during each turn he will choose a city for a Monument randomly among all remaining cities (cities without Monuments). Monocarp wants to know how many points (among m%%ZSMJ7%% of them) he will conquer at the end of turn number n%%ZSMJ8%%. Help him to calculate the expected number of conquered points!
input: The first line contains two integers n%%ZSMJ9%% and m%%ZSMJ10%% (1≤n≤20%%ZSMJ11%%; 1≤m≤5⋅104%%ZSMJ12%%) — the number of cities and the number of points.

Next n%%ZSMJ13%% lines contains m%%ZSMJ14%% integers each: the j%%ZSMJ15%%-th integer of the i%%ZSMJ16%%-th line di,j%%ZSMJ17%% (1≤di,j≤n+1%%ZSMJ18%%) is the distance between the i%%ZSMJ19%%-th city and the j%%ZSMJ20%%-th point.
output: It can be shown that the expected number of points Monocarp conquers at the end of the n%%ZSMJ21%%-th turn can be represented as an irreducible fraction xy%%ZSMJ22%%. Print this fraction modulo 998244353%%ZSMJ23%%, i. e. value x⋅y−1mod998244353%%ZSMJ24%% where y−1%%ZSMJ25%% is such number that y⋅y−1mod998244353=1%%ZSMJ26%%.
note: Let's look at all possible orders of cities Monuments will be build in:

the second city controls all points at distance at most 2%%ZSMJ31%%, or points 1%%ZSMJ32%%, 3%%ZSMJ33%% and 5%%ZSMJ34%%;
the third city controls all points at distance at most 1%%ZSMJ35%%, or point 1%%ZSMJ36%%.
[1,3,2]%%ZSMJ38%%: the first city controls points 1%%ZSMJ39%% and 4%%ZSMJ40%%; the second city — points 1%%ZSMJ41%% and 3%%ZSMJ42%%; the third city — point 1%%ZSMJ43%%. In total, 3%%ZSMJ44%% points.
